name: Xu Zhou
title: Assistant Professor
bio:
I am an Assistant Professor at Penn State and lead the **Food Engineering & AI Lab**. Our team integrates **Food Science**, **Engineering**, and **Artificial Intelligence (AI)** to advance next-generation food manufacturing.

Our group develops advanced food processing technologies and AI systems for next-generation food manufacturing systems. Our long-term goal is to develop autonomous, self-driving food engineering laboratories and factories. Currently, we focus on digital twins (sensing, simulation, AI, and robotics) for food processing and supply chains.

Previously, I was a Postdoctoral Scholar at [AI Institute for Food Systems](https://aifs.ucdavis.edu/) (advisor: [Dr. Ilias Tagkopoulos](https://faculty.engineering.ucdavis.edu/tagkopoulos/biography/)). I earned my Ph.D. in Food Engineering (advisor: [Dr. Juming Tang](https://www.me.washington.edu/facultyfinder/juming-tang)), a master's degree in Agricultural Engineering, and a bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering.
